venture/allocator-policy.code:
"""The allocator: moves money toward where the edge is, within caps Brody sets.

Coinbase is the one place money comes in; this spreads it. Policy, once per
cycle after the audit (so NAV is fresh):
  0. convert           — cash that lands as USD becomes USDC (the rails send USDC only)
  1. gas floors        — the DeFi wallet never runs dry: buy POL/ETH with USDC when
                         Coinbase has none (capped by gas_buy_max_usd), then send it
  2. Kalshi top-up     — on demand (the strategy found edge it could not size), or up
                         to its target (kalshi_topup = target); only to a verified
                         Kalshi deposit address. The target is held down to what the
                         shadow book's proof gate has unlocked (target_follows_proof):
                         this only limits new top-ups, it never takes money back out
  3. harvest flag      — Kalshi above its target band: a finding, never a send
                         (Kalshi has no crypto withdrawals)
  4. park (optional)   — Coinbase cash beyond the reserve → the wallet → Aave

Modes: ``propose`` (every move waits for a one-keypress approval in the TUI),
``auto_capped`` (moves within per-transfer / per-day caps go now, larger ones
wait), ``auto`` (no caps; kill file only). Housekeeping that never leaves
Coinbase's control (the conversion, gas buys and the gas send itself) runs on
its own in every mode while ``housekeeping_auto`` is on. A weekly drawdown beyond
risk_global.max_weekly_drawdown_pct forces ``propose``. ``logs/ALLOCATOR_HALT``
stops everything. Only ever between accounts Brody owns: the system's own
wallet and saved payees.
"""

superset/key-cost.code:
@staticmethod
    def _key_cost(key_a: str | None, key_b: str | None) -> float:
        """Return a [0, 1] transition cost using the 24-node Camelot wheel.

        Distance is the shortest graph path between the two Camelot positions
        (clock distance + 1 if mode differs), normalised by 6 (the maximum
        clock distance).  Unrecognised keys fall back to 0.5 (neutral).
        """
        if not key_a or not key_b:
            return 0.5
        pos_a = _CAMELOT_MAP.get(key_a)
        pos_b = _CAMELOT_MAP.get(key_b)
        if pos_a is None or pos_b is None:
            return 0.5
        h_a, m_a = pos_a
        h_b, m_b = pos_b
        clock = abs(h_a - h_b)
        clock = min(clock, 12 - clock)
        mode = 0 if m_a == m_b else 1
        dist = clock + mode
        return min(1.0, dist / 6.0)
